race:history:01.text: Quale città antica era il centro di un impero governato da imperatori come Augusto?

race:history:02.text: Quale civiltà delle Ande costruì Machu Picchu?

race:history:03.text: Quale popolo della Mesoamerica fondò Tenochtitlan?

race:history:04.text: A quale dinastia reale inglese appartenevano Enrico VIII ed Elisabetta I?

race:history:05.text: Come si chiama un navigatore nordico che compiva razzie e commerciava in tutta Europa?

race:history:06.text: Quale condottiero romano attraversò il Rubicone nel 49 a.C.?

race:history:07.text: Quale leader dell'indipendenza indiana era noto per la resistenza non violenta?

race:history:08.text: Quale città-stato greca era famosa per la sua società guerriera?

race:history:09.text: Quale antica civiltà costruì le piramidi di Giza?

race:history:10.text: Qual è la prima parola del nome della carta su cui re Giovanni appose il sigillo nel 1215?

race:history:v2:11.text: Quale famosa nave passeggeri affondò dopo aver urtato un iceberg nel 1912?

race:history:v2:12.text: Quale città tedesca rimase divisa da un muro fino al 1989?

race:history:v2:13.text: Quale città commerciale italiana è famosa per i canali e le gondole?

race:history:v2:14.text: Quale materiale per scrivere, ricavato da canne, usavano gli antichi egizi?

race:history:v2:15.text: Quale città ospitò i primi Giochi olimpici moderni nel 1896?

race:history:01.backTranslation: Which ancient city was the center of an empire ruled by emperors such as Augustus?

race:history:02.backTranslation: Which civilization of the Andes built Machu Picchu?

race:history:04.backTranslation: To which English royal dynasty did Henry VIII and Elizabeth I belong?

race:history:05.backTranslation: What is a Norse seafarer who raided and traded throughout Europe called?

race:history:06.backTranslation: Which Roman military leader crossed the Rubicon in 49 BCE?

race:history:07.backTranslation: Which Indian independence leader was known for nonviolent resistance?

race:history:08.backTranslation: Which Greek city-state was famous for its warrior society?

race:history:09.backTranslation: Which ancient civilization built the pyramids of Giza?

race:history:10.backTranslation: What is the first word in the name of the charter on which King John placed his seal in 1215?

race:history:v2:11.backTranslation: Which famous passenger ship sank after hitting an iceberg in 1912?

race:history:v2:12.backTranslation: Which German city remained divided by a wall until 1989?

race:history:v2:13.backTranslation: Which Italian trading city is famous for its canals and gondolas?

race:history:v2:14.backTranslation: What writing material, made from reeds, did the ancient Egyptians use?

race:history:v2:15.backTranslation: Which city hosted the first modern Olympic Games in 1896?
